Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay momentum-focused: 

- Key discovery notes: primary use case is real-time summarization across internal docs + embeddings-based semantic search for product support. Latency target is sub-200ms for short responses; expected QPS ~50-100 for beta.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in time-to-resolution on support tickets & < $0.001/token for inference unit economics once in production.
- Open items: security/compliance (SOC 2 evidence + retention), exact infra model (private vs dedicated), and exec alignment on ROI/implementation timeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Exec alignment call (VP of Eng / CTO) - 30 min - purpose: confirm high-level architecture choices and unblock procurement/POC.
2) Technical deep dive / demo - 60 min - with Logan (solutions), Marcus (SE) - technical architecture, integration patterns, quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Can you share Jason Miller (CTO) and your VP-of-Eng availability next week? Below are a couple of windows we have:
- Tue 22 Jun: 10:00-11:00 PT or 14:00-15:00 PT
- Wed 23 Jun: 11:00-11:30 PT (short executive sync)
- Thu 24 Jun: 15:00-16:00 PT (technical deep dive slot)

I've attached a 1-page exec deck and a draft mutual action plan to help the call be efficient. Logan / Marcus - can you block tentative time for Thu 24 for a 60 min deep dive (we'll update once Jason confirms)?

Thanks - looking forward to getting Jason looped in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
